scope: Selected publications output and evidence coverage; no impact judgement
grain: One included canonical publication per selected snapshot

date_roles.publication: Usable day/month precision only for month plots; year-only, uncertain or absent dates remain outside month cohorts and visible as unknown
date_roles.cutoff: CutoffExclusive is the first day after the last complete Brisbane calendar month; never provider freshness
date_roles.capture: CapturedUTC is model evaluation/processing time; never provider acquisition or publication time
date_roles.observation: Dated retained OpenAlex OA observation; not current full-text availability

views.current: Restated current projection; retain source batches and independent metric/model/report versions
views.technical_baseline: Immutable reviewed technical capture, explicitly not issued
views.original-unavailable: No issued original is evidenced; values remain blank and Availability false; do not reconstruct from current rows

K01.label: Publication outputs in complete months
K01.numerator: Distinct included canonical works with usable month in the selected complete reporting window
K01.aggregation: Distinct works; facility category totals are non-additive
K01.missingness: Unknown-month count shown separately; do not assign artificial dates
K01.interpretation: Output activity; no quality or impact inference

K02.label: Known open-access share among assessed publications
K02.aggregation: Recompute from distinct work totals; never average percentages
K02.missingness: Absent, undated, conflicting or unsupported OA is unknown; zero assessed denominator returns blank
K02.interpretation: Retained OA status evidence, not institutional coverage or accessible full text

D01.label: OA evidence assessment coverage
D01.aggregation: Recompute in the same snapshot/facility/date/source context
D01.missingness: Zero included denominator returns blank; unknown OA remains explicit
D01.interpretation: Coverage of this retained evidence field only; no workforce or whole-institution denominator

change_control: Keep legacy count/export semantics. Introduce a new metric version/name for changed semantics; reconcile dependent plots, details and exports before deprecating the old measure. Never rewrite frozen baseline source to match current totals.

future_dependencies.funding: Accepted award/application/opportunity distinctions, effective periods and currency/share semantics
future_dependencies.translation_and_outcomes: Authoritative retained events/observations, comparator, observation horizon and verification; no classifications or impact judgements inferred
